limits: The external search endpoint is controlled and independently checks the native comparator. Original dispatcher/comparator instructions run only in bounded Unicorn.

All-bit reduction, callback rebinding, row count growth/shrinkage and context-array replacement are covered. Actual key-list construction, allocator, callback implementations, concurrency and live input-query connection remain open.
The comparator preserves DWORD subtraction with wrap. Ordering at signed wrap boundaries is not replaced with an assumed normalized unsigned order.
